name: Slow Cooker Broccoli Beef
desc: Thin-sliced flank steak slow-cooked in a sweet soy and garlic sauce, thickened at the end and tossed with steamed broccoli.

source.title: Slow Cooker Broccoli Beef
source.evidence: All ten ingredients match the site in order and amount; supplies the chili flake amount (1/4 tsp).

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb flank steak, thinly sliced across the grain and cut into 2-inch pieces
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced across the grain and cut into 2-inch pieces

ingredients.raw: Nonstick cooking spray, for the slow cooker

steps: Grease the inside of the slow cooker. Add the steak, broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and chili flakes and stir.
Cover and cook on low 4-5 hours or on high 2-3 hours, until the beef is fork-tender.
Whisk the cornstarch and cold water in a small bowl until dissolved. Stir it into the slow cooker, cover, and cook until the sauce thickens, 20-25 min.

Just before serving, put the broccoli in a microwave-safe container with 1/2 inch of water, set the lid on loosely so it can vent, and microwave on high until bright green and crisp-tender, about 3 min. Drain.
Stir the broccoli into the beef and serve.
tips: Partly freezing the flank steak (about 30 min) makes thin slicing much easier.
